description: This Java class 'ExpressionUiHelper' provides utility methods for handling temporal expression UI artifacts, including generating lists of date/time components, expression types, and candidate IDs for inclusion, primarily used in the context of calendar and scheduling features within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ExpressionUiHelper
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for generating date/time lists, expression types, and candidate IDs related to temporal expressions.

methods.name: getOccurrenceList
methods.description: Returns a list of valid DayInMonth occurrence integers.

methods.name: getDayValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for days of the week based on locale.

methods.name: getFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week for the given locale.

methods.name: getLastDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the last day of the week for the given locale.

methods.name: getMonthValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for months based on locale.

methods.name: getFrequencyValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for frequency units.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for different temporal expression types.

methods.name: getCandidateIncludeIds
methods.description: Returns a set of candidate temporal expression IDs for inclusion, excluding current and related IDs.
